reason: The full correctness pass through 5fdcb62 found seven reachable production gaps, four source-contract clarity defects, and one invalid live-consumer recipe. The fixed recipe's full-moon More prompt consumed the teleport inputs, so the earlier three-case result is not evidence. The review findings are tracked in QUALITY.json and this checklist returns to implementation until the expanded boundary is implemented and freshly proved.

boundary.startingEvent: The Enter that submits a positive decimal answer at 'To what level do you want to teleport?'. js/teleport.js level_tele() has echoed the line and classified the four literal answers, and throws UnsupportedLevelChangeError('level_tele() resolving a typed destination') where objnam-style resolution would begin. Both dispatch routes already reach that point, so this slice adds no dispatch work.
boundary.endingEvent: The arrival screen goto_level() paints for the destination level, after u_on_rndspot() has placed the hero. Measured at seed 5514004, moves '.\x162\n.', datetime 20300214113000, Wizard/human/male/neutral, pettype:none,!acoustics,playmode:debug: C produces 6 screens where the port produces 4, and C's first unmatched draw is rn2(3) from getbones(bones.c:645).
boundary.validInputs: A wizard-mode game whose typed answer is a decimal string for which lev_by_name() returns 0 and atoi() a positive newlev; single_level_branch(&u.uz) and In_quest(&u.uz) false and next_to_u() true; get_level() resolving newlev inside dnum 0 to a level whose level_info[].flags lacks LFILE_EXISTS; and goto_level() running with at_stairs, falling and portal all FALSE. The hero must not be confused, or teleport.c:1216 spends an rnl(5) no recording holds.
boundary.observables: The arrival screen and its cursor; the random-number calls the destination level's mklev() spends, beginning with C's rn2(3) at getbones(bones.c:645); place_lregion()'s rn1((hx-lx)+1, lx) and rn1((hy-ly)+1, ly) pair per try, including the roughly three-in-four tries that fail the ROOM test and retry; and the hero's resulting position, which the next command reads back.
boundary.exclusions: print_dungeon() and the '?' answer; '*' and the random_levtport arm; negative levels with their heaven, Nowhere and done() paths; the In_endgame arm; the non-wizard Teleport_control route; level_tele_trap() and mlevel_tele_trap(); any destination that is a special level or one already generated; and put_lregion_here()'s deterministic oneshot pass with deltrap(), rloc() and m_into_limbo(), which needs 200 consecutive failures to reach.

candidateListMethod.upstreamEntryPoints: teleport.c level_tele() 1250-1424, the tail; dungeon.c lev_by_name() 2098-2170, get_level() 1802-1846, u_on_rndspot() 1605-1638, single_level_branch() 1967-1975; do.c schedule_goto() 2056-2070, deferred_goto() 2074-2102, maybe_lvltport_feedback() 2031-2040, and goto_level()'s else arrival arm 1802-1810 with its call at 1853-1855; mkmaze.c is_exclusion_zone() 316-332, bad_location() 340-352, place_lregion() 355-408, put_lregion_here() 412-467; allmain.c moveloop_core() 538-539.
candidateListMethod.dispatchTablesAndCatalogs: dungeon.c's dungeons[] and level_info[] flags, read by get_level() for LFILE_EXISTS, and the branch chain find_branch() walks. No new table is copied by this slice.
candidateListMethod.reachableHelpers: mklev.c occupied() 1806-1812 is already ported, at js/mktrap.js:158, and bad_location() must call it rather than a second copy. next_to_u() is ported at js/apply_next_to_u.js and answers TRUE for an ordinary hero with a pet, so level_tele()'s You1(shudder_for_moment) guard passes without new work. find_level() is ported at js/dungeon.js:803. In_W_tower() and On_W_tower_level() are unported and needed for goto_level()'s was_in_W_tower; both are false above the Wizard's tower, so a small ported guard suffices.
candidateListMethod.javascriptCrossCheck: Verified at 496e4f3 by the orchestrator, not accepted from a report. js/teleport.js throws UnsupportedLevelChangeError('level_tele() resolving a typed destination') where the resolution begins. grep -c UnsupportedLevelChangeError js/jsmain.js returns 0, so that class is not among the six boundary classes js/jsmain.js:527-549 breaks a segment for; it sits only in failClosedCommandRefusals() (js/cmd.js:919), which the command wrapper alone consults. js/mklev.js:200-238 stubs place_lregion() and bad_location() as 'simplified for skeleton', and no js/mkmaze.js exists. js/stairs.js:87-94 holds duplicate dunlev() and single_level_branch() behind a comment saying they stay there rather than becoming a dungeon.c port they do not represent; this slice retires that justification. js/allmain.js:626 elapsedTurnPlanningRefusals() is the wrapper the turn loop already uses, and js/allmain.js:940-946 holds the two rhack() call sites the new site follows.
candidateListMethod.remainingLimits: The formal pass proved that the previous three-case recipe never crossed the prompt, and reproduced reachable stops for special-room generation, the ordinary Quest entrance, shop entry, object-bearing autopickup, dwarf earth sense, overflowing decimal conversion, and a numeric destination resolving to a special level. Those source families and a corrected live recipe now belong to this slice. The deterministic oneshot cleanup after 200 failures and restored levels remain explicit exclusions.

sourceReview: The full correctness pass through 5fdcb62 traced teleport.c level_tele(); do.c schedule_goto(), deferred_goto(), goto_level() and arrival feedback; dungeon.c topology and random placement helpers; mkmaze.c region placement; allmain.c's post-rhack call; every affected caller and focused test; and all 27 mutation survivors. It invalidated the earlier live matrix and identified reachable generator, Quest-entrance, shop, pickup, earth-sense, integer-conversion and special-level gaps plus four source-contract clarity defects. The source boundary is therefore not complete; implementation must expand through those first observables before readiness can be claimed again.
